summary: Applied both triaged blocking findings by adding a durable reviewStop state contract and a child-to-wrapper review failure marker contract.

items.title: Provider and input failures have no durable stop-state path
items.rationale: The spec now requires run-review to persist classified review stops in flow.json reviewStop, defines the fields, and states when that stop state is cleared. R3/R5/R6 now reference reviewStop so follow-up next-action/status commands have a durable state source.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.data_flow[] defines reviewStop write/read/clear; requirements R3/R5/R6 reference flow.json reviewStop; acceptance_criteria includes reviewStop persistence and clearing checks.

items.title: Provider failure classification lacks a child-to-wrapper contract
items.rationale: The spec now requires src/flow/commands/review.js to emit a one-line machine-readable stderr marker for provider/input failures and requires src/flow/lib/run-review.js to parse that marker before raw stderr fallback.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.data_flow[] defines the marker path; requirement R9 defines the marker contract; implementationTargets includes src/flow/commands/review.js; T-2 acceptance/notes and acceptance_criteria cover marker parsing.
